meta.asymmetry_note: Kingsport inventory rows are grounded in a complete official catalog (36 parks + 11 youth programs + 8 named cultural partners from kingsportparksandrecreation.org + kingsporttn.gov). Memphis inventory rows cover marquee institutions + confirmed private/commercial players, but the full Memphis/Shelby park catalog could not be fetched (memphistn.gov + shelbycountytn.gov 403), so Memphis's low-tier city-asset count is understated. Density comparison should read Kingsport's 3.36 KPR parks per 1k kids as an upper-bound contrast to Memphis's 0.17 floor, not a true ratio.

site_comparison.pattern: Kingsport is far denser in tax-subsidized city assets per 1k kids (e.g. 38 KPR parks per 1k kids = 3.36/1k vs Memphis 0.17/1k) - BUT Kingsport is a single city w/ small kid pop while Memphis rows are listed at city level without a comprehensive parks catalog fetched (memphistn.gov 403-blocked). Memphis clearly wins on marquee tax-subsidized institutions (Zoo, MoSH/Pink Palace, CMOM, Brooks, Botanic Garden).
site_comparison.caveat: Apples-to-oranges: KPR count is a verified full catalog from kingsportparksandrecreation.org; Memphis parks catalog (cityofmemphis) was 403-blocked so Memphis undercounts low-tier city assets.
